description: This file provides utility functions for handling dates specifically in the format YYYY-MM-DD. It includes functions for converting Date objects to ISO strings, parsing ISO date strings into Date objects, adding days, calculating differences, generating date ranges, and grouping dates by week. These utilities are used across a habit and task tracking dashboard to manage date-related operations.

methods.name: toISODateString(date)
methods.description: Converts a Date object to a YYYY-MM-DD formatted string in local time.

methods.name: parseISODateString(iso)
methods.description: Parses a YYYY-MM-DD string into a Date object in local time.

methods.name: addDays(iso, deltaDays)
methods.description: Adds a specified number of days to an ISO date string and returns the new date as an ISO string.

methods.name: diffDays(aISO, bISO)
methods.description: Calculates the difference in whole days between two ISO date strings.

methods.name: getTodayISO()
methods.description: Returns the current date as a YYYY-MM-DD ISO string.

methods.name: getLastNDaysRange(n, endISO = getTodayISO())
methods.description: Returns an array of ISO date strings for the last N days ending at the specified end date (default today).

methods.name: getLastNDays(n, endDate = new Date())
methods.description: Returns an array of Date objects for the last N days ending at the specified end date (default today).

methods.name: getLastNWeeks({ weeks = 12, endISO = getTodayISO(), weekStartsOn = 1 } = {})
methods.description: Returns a range of ISO dates for the last N weeks ending at a specified date (default today), aligned to week starts.

methods.name: startOfWeekISO(iso, weekStartsOn = 1)
methods.description: Calculates the start of the week (ISO date string) for a given date, considering week start day.

methods.name: groupISOByWeek(isoDates, weekStartsOn = 1)
methods.description: Groups an array of ISO date strings into buckets keyed by week start ISO date.

methods.name: clampISOToRange(iso, startISO, endISO)
methods.description: Clamps an ISO date string within a specified start and end range.

ctags.name: getLastNWeeks
ctags.pattern: /^export function getLastNWeeks({ weeks = 12, endISO = getTodayISO(), weekStartsOn = 1 } = {}) {$/
